# 100X Circle

> 100X Circle Pvt Ltd is an Indian OEM manufacturer of pulse-jet thermal fogging machines and cold (ULV) foggers for municipal mosquito and vector control, public health and agricultural use. In business since 2020. Factory at IMT Manesar, Gurugram, Haryana, India. GeM-listed, ISO 9001, CE, ISI certified. MSME/UDYAM registered. Exports to South Asia, Africa, and the Middle East. Machines are sold directly and on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM), and resellers can get an OEM authorization letter to offer them in GeM bids.

Last updated: 2026-10-09

All facts below come from the company's published catalogue and website.

## Company

- Legal name: 100X Circle Private Limited (100X Circle Pvt Ltd)
- Brands: 100X, Instafog
- Type: Indian OEM manufacturer, private limited company
- In business since: 2020
- Factory and office: UG, 398, Sector 7, Industrial Model Township (IMT Manesar), Gurugram, Haryana 122050, India
- Coordinates: 28.3874°N, 76.9318°E
- MSME/UDYAM: Registered
- Sells on GeM: yes (Government e-Marketplace, gem.gov.in)
- Quality standard: ISO 9001:2015
- Processes: product design/engineering, metal fabrication and welding, pulse-jet engine assembly, fuel system assembly, chemical delivery system assembly, quality control and testing, packaging and dispatch
- Industry: industrial equipment manufacturing (thermal and cold fogging machines, agricultural equipment)
- NAICS: 333999 | ISIC: 2819
- Track record as published on the site: 500+ government orders, 80+ departments, 2,000+ units supplied, 50+ dealers and distributors, 24 published case studies. Past-performance register: https://www.100xcircle.com/past-performance-government

## Products (live catalogue, 9 fogging machine models)

Prices: on request. Specifications are each model's own published values.

### 100XTFS50 — Thermal and Cold Fogging Machine
- Type: pulse-jet fogger with thermal and cold modes
- Tanks: 7 L chemical + 7 L water; start: 12V battery push-button; output: 50-100 L/hour; empty weight: 8 kg
- Use: outdoor vector control (thermal) and indoor disinfection (cold); available on GeM
- URL: https://www.100xcircle.com/thermal-and-cold-fogging-machine-100xtfs50

### 100XDB400 — Double Barrel Thermal Fogging Machine (Vehicle Mountable)
- Type: double-barrel pulse-jet thermal fogger for vehicles (pickup, small truck, e-rickshaw or other flat-bed)
- Tanks: 100 L stainless steel chemical tank, 16 L fuel tank; output: 80-100 L/hour; start: electric, from the vehicle's 12V battery; wired remote from the driver's cabin
- Use: municipal ward fogging drives, large-area vector control; available on GeM
- Certifications: GeM eligible, ISO 9001
- URL: https://www.100xcircle.com/double-barrel-thermal-fogging-machine-vehicle-mountable-100xdb400

### 100XSSMA20 — Thermal Fogging Machine with Stainless Steel Tank
- Type: hand-carried pulse-jet thermal fogger
- Tanks: 7 L stainless steel chemical tank, 1.5 L fuel tank; output: up to 40 L/hour; start: 12V electric auto-start; droplet size: 8-20 microns
- Use: pest control operators, municipal and disinfection work; available on GeM
- URL: https://www.100xcircle.com/thermal-fogging-machine-with-stainless-steel-tank-100xssma20

### 100XHM20 — ISI Marked Thermal Fogging Machine (HDPE Tank)
- Type: hand-carried pulse-jet thermal fogger
- Tanks: 5.5 L HDPE solution tank, 2 L HDPE fuel tank; output: 30-40 L/hour adjustable; start: manual; weight: 7.5 kg
- Certification: ISI Mark, ISO 9001, WHO complied
- Use: government procurement, municipal mosquito and vector control; available on GeM
- URL: https://www.100xcircle.com/products/isi-marked-thermal-fogging-machine-with-hdpe-tank-100xhm20-fcbbde

### 100XHBL22 — Pulse Jet Thermal Fogging Machine (HDPE Tank)
- Type: hand-carried pulse-jet thermal fogger
- Tanks: 6 L HDPE solution tank, 2 L HDPE fuel tank; output: 30-40 L/hour adjustable; start: manual, replaceable dry-cell batteries; weight: 7.5 kg
- Certification: ISI Mark, ISO 9001, WHO complied
- Use: government procurement, municipal use; available on GeM
- URL: https://www.100xcircle.com/products/isi-marked-thermal-fogging-machine-with-hdpe-tank-100xhbl22-c-ea7f75

### 100XMCF42 — Cold Fogger with 2-Stroke Engine
- Type: cold fogger / mist sprayer, 2-stroke petrol engine, no heat
- Tank: 14 L chemical; droplet size: 20-100 microns adjustable; spray distance: 8-16 m; water-based and oil-based formulations
- Use: disinfection, hospitals, food facilities, vector control, crop protection; available on GeM
- URL: https://www.100xcircle.com/products/cold-fogger-machine-with-2-stoke-engine-100xmcf42-c42ca1

### 100XULV22 — ULV Cold Fogger (Electric)
- Type: ULV cold fogger, 230V single-phase AC, counter-rotating vortex nozzle
- Tank: 7 L chemical; droplet size: 0.5-30 microns adjustable; spray distance: 20-40 ft
- Use: disinfection in hospitals and food facilities; available on GeM
- URL: https://www.100xcircle.com/products/ulv-cold-fogger-machine-100xmcf42-copy-8dcd42lvlv

### 100XULVSS10 — ULV Electric Cold Fogger / Mist Sprayer
- Type: ULV cold fogger, 240V single-phase AC, one counter-rotating vortex nozzle
- Tank: 5 L chemical; droplet size: 0.5-30 microns adjustable; spray distance: 20-40 ft; water-based and oil-based liquids
- Use: disinfection work
- URL: https://www.100xcircle.com/products/100xulvss10-5e46c5

### 100XBF102 — Mini Fogger
- Type: hand-held mini fogger, butane gas, ignition-switch start
- Tank: 2.5 L PE chemical tank; output: 2.5 L/hour; weight: 1.2 kg
- Use: mosquito control in small areas (gardens, lawns, farmhouses, warehouses)
- URL: https://www.100xcircle.com/products/mini-fogger-100xbf102-2d9887

- Direct supply to government departments, municipalities, pest control operators, farms and institutions across India
- GeM supply: government buyers can order listed models on GeM
- OEM authorization letters for resellers bidding with our machines on GeM or in tenders (a GeM Seller ID is optional when you request one): https://www.100xcircle.com/oem-authorization-letter
- Tender documents: technical datasheets and the IS 14855 test report on request: https://www.100xcircle.com/gem-tender-support
- Spare parts: 120+ parts listed, dispatched in 24-48 hours: https://www.100xcircle.com/spare-parts
- Dealer programme: https://www.100xcircle.com/become-a-dealer
- Quotations: within 24 hours on working days
- Distribution: 50+ active dealers and distributors across India; pan-India dispatch from Gurugram
- Standard delivery: 5-10 working days for in-stock models
- Export: South Asia, Africa, Middle East (CE-marked models)

## Certifications and Compliance

- ISO 9001:2015: Quality Management System — all manufacturing operations
- CE Marking: European conformity certification for export models
- ISI Mark: Bureau of Indian Standards approval (select models, including 100XHM20 and 100XHBL22)
- IS 14855: thermal fogging machines are built to the requirements of IS 14855; the test report is available on request
- MSME/UDYAM: Government of India MSME registration — enables 25% procurement preference on GeM
- GeM: Government e-Marketplace approved seller (direct government purchase, no tender required for eligible buyers)

## Technical Specifications (Thermal Fogging Technology)

- Operating Principle: Pulse-jet resonant combustion at 40–100 Hz
- Combustion Temperature: 400–600°C
- Droplet Size: 1–50 microns MVD (WHO recommends 10–30 microns for mosquito control); see each model above for its own figure
- Fog Airborne Duration: 5–15 minutes
- Compatible Insecticides: Oil-based formulations (deltamethrin, cypermethrin, malathion, permethrin)
- Contraindicated: Water-based formulations not suitable for thermal fogging (cold / ULV and dual-mode machines take water-based liquids; see each model)
- Thermal fogging suits large outdoor areas; cold (ULV) fogging suits indoor and sensitive spaces: https://www.100xcircle.com/thermal-vs-cold-fogging-machine

## Applications

- Municipal mosquito control and vector-borne disease prevention (dengue, malaria, chikungunya)
- Public health fogging drives by municipal corporations, Nagar Nigams, Nagar Panchayats and district health departments
- Agricultural pest management and crop protection; agriculture fogging for farms, orchards and storage
- Indoor disinfection in hospitals, food facilities and warehouses (cold / ULV)
- Industrial estates, housing societies and pest control operators

## Government Supply Experience

- Supplies to municipal corporations, Nagar Nigams, Nagar Panchayats across India
- GeM-listed for direct government procurement
- States served: Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Rajasthan, Haryana, Punjab, and others
- Emergency dengue/malaria outbreak response supply via GeM direct procurement pathway
- 2022–2025: Multiple municipalities in Haryana, UP, Bihar used vehicle-mounted 50-litre pulse-jet foggers
- Farm cooperative societies in Punjab and Haryana use portable models under shared-use schemes
- 50+ active pest control operators (PCOs) expanded fleets from 1–2 to 5–10 machines
- Export customers in South Asia, Africa, Middle East: 40–60% cost advantage vs European alternatives

## Comparison Position

- 100X Circle (Indian OEM) vs Korean imported foggers: 3–5× lower cost, local spares, GeM eligible, no import delays
- 100X Circle vs European/German foggers: Indian pricing, faster delivery, MSME preference on GeM
- Thermal fogging vs generic sprayers: fog penetrates vegetation and voids that sprayers cannot reach
- Thermal fogging vs ULV cold fogging: thermal ideal for large outdoor areas; ULV preferred for indoor use

Headquartered at IMT Manesar, Gurugram. 9 thermal and cold fogging models in the current catalog; pricing available on request. 50+ dealers. Exports to South Asia, Africa, Middle East.

## FAQ

Q: Who makes 100X fogging machines?
A: 100X Circle Pvt Ltd, an Indian OEM manufacturer in business since 2020, at its factory in IMT Manesar, Gurugram, Haryana.

Q: Can government departments buy 100X fogging machines on GeM?
A: Yes. Listed models can be bought on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM). See https://www.100xcircle.com/gem-approved-fogging-machine-oem

Q: How does a reseller get an OEM authorization letter?
A: A GeM Seller ID is optional. Request the letter at https://www.100xcircle.com/oem-authorization-letter

Q: Are the machines built to IS 14855?
A: The thermal fogging machines are built to the requirements of IS 14855 and the test report is available on request. 100XHM20 and 100XHBL22 carry the ISI mark.

Q: Which machine is for outdoor mosquito control and which for indoor disinfection?
A: Thermal foggers (for example 100XHM20, 100XHBL22, 100XSSMA20, 100XDB400) for outdoor vector control; cold / ULV foggers (100XMCF42, 100XULV22, 100XULVSS10) for indoor disinfection; 100XTFS50 does both.

Q: How fast are spare parts dispatched?
A: In 24-48 hours. 120+ parts are listed at https://www.100xcircle.com/spare-parts

Q: How quickly do you reply to a quotation request?
A: Within 24 hours on working days.

Q: What should a fogging machine tender specify?
A: Machine type, form factor, tank capacities, output, droplet size, power and start, the standard (IS 14855 for thermal foggers), documents, warranty, spares and training. See https://www.100xcircle.com/fogging-machine-tender-specification-checklist
